name: Sakanaya-san
source:
It's not shameful. It's beautiful. Little Natsuki-chan entrusts herself fully to the will of the master.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这有什么好羞耻的？这明明很美。小夏希就这样将自己完全托付给了主人，任由对方决定一切。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
